headline: TfL takes Oyster photocard site offline after data breach
summary: Transport for London took its Oyster photocard website offline after attackers compromised customer accounts. TfL says around 265,000 customers may have had their account details exposed in the breach. One outlet notes this is the latest in a series of security incidents affecting the transport operator.
